name: Dressing Up For Church
overview: Scripture teaches that outward appearance, including dress, should reflect godly order and respect without causing division or judgment among believers. Deuteronomy 22:5 emphasizes clear distinctions in attire according to God's design, while James 2:1 warns against showing favoritism based on outward appearances. Romans 14 encourages believers to accept those with differing convictions about such matters without disputation or judgment, recognizing that all will stand before Christ's judgment seat. Ultimately, Revelation 19:8 reminds us that true worth is found in the righteousness of the saints, symbolized by fine, clean linen, pointing us to prioritize spiritual purity over external garments.
